item.title: IPRS Returns to Kala Ghoda Arts Festival 2026 with Focus on Original and Licensed Music
item.description: IPRS returns to Kala Ghoda Arts Festival 2026 with curated performances spotlighting licensed music, regional originals, and living cultural traditions.

item.title: Percept Live and Laqshya Media Group Announce Bollyboom’s ‘Chak De India Tour’ with Salim–Sulaiman
item.description: Percept Live and Laqshya Media Group announce Bollyboom’s ‘Chak De India Tour’, a multi-city concert celebrating 33 years of Salim–Sulaiman’s music, starting March 21, 2026.

item.title: Messe Frankfurt Trade Fairs India partners with BusinessLive Trade Fairs to expand Media Expo footprint across India
item.description: Messe Frankfurt Trade Fairs India and BusinessLive Trade Fairs have partnered to expand Media Expo, transitioning Sign India Expo into the Media Expo brand and extending its presence to five Indian cities.

item.title: Mahindra Percussion Festival 2026 Returns to Bengaluru With a Pan-India Celebration of Rhythm
item.description: The Mahindra Percussion Festival returns to Bengaluru on March 7–8, 2026, bringing together maestros and contemporary artists to celebrate India’s diverse rhythmic traditions.

item.title: Awayddings Raises ₹2 Crore on Shark Tank India with Focus on Affordable Destination Weddings
item.description: Featured on Shark Tank India, Awayddings closed a ₹2 crore deal to expand its organised destination wedding planning platform.

item.title: Manvir Singh Anand on How Knight Gourmet Is Shaping Sports Hospitality in India
item.description: Manvir Singh Anand explains how Knight Gourmet is positioning hospitality as core infrastructure within India’s rapidly expanding live experiences and sports ecosystem.

item.title: Sanchalli Arora: The Global Voice Behind High-Stakes Stages
item.description: Sanchalli Arora is a globally trusted host, seamlessly anchoring diplomacy, MICE, and luxury celebrations with effortless poise.

item.title: Sarod Virtuoso Soumik Datta and Bharatanatyam Dancer Mythili Prakash to Headline Two-Day Festival Sahaj in Chennai
item.description: Sarod virtuoso Soumik Datta and Bharatanatyam dancer Mythili Prakash headline Sahaj, a two-day music and dance festival in Chennai this February.

item.title: India Makes Its Mark as FUJIFILM instax™️ Undisputed Breaking Championship Debuts in New Delhi
item.description: The first-ever FUJIFILM instax™️ Undisputed India Qualifier wrapped up in New Delhi, with Japan’s Yuina and Ryoga winning the Solo battles.

item.title: Second Edition of Indian Navy Half Marathon Held in New Delhi
item.description: The second edition of the Indian Navy Half Marathon was held in New Delhi on February 1, 2026, with runners competing in 21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km categories, celebrating fitness and national pride.
